'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Isaac Proctor DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Isaac Proctor]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
